title: Left 4 Dead 2
notes: Hotel chapter of a fresh Dead Center campaign on Easy (owner decisions: Easy instead of the hardest level because on Expert the human died within 30 minutes without leaving the rooftop area; the chapter is the whole task because even Easy proved too hard to finish it). One human survivor and three native survivor bots, sv_cheats=0. Read-only native event instrumentation; recovery rejected. Vulkan/lavapipe software rendering at native 640x360 low preset. Keyboard-only input profile: turning and looking use bound keys, mouse binds are removed and mouse motion is inert, so both model forms share the same buttons. Pause is SIGSTOP of the game process; frozen steps advance native time by the step only (verified in VALIDATION.md). The score is the whole percentage of the navigation-mesh route from the rooftop to the safe room that the living human has covered (route.json, derived from the game's own navigation file).
introduction: Left 4 Dead 2 is a first-person cooperative shooter. Four survivors, one of them controlled by you and three by the computer, fight through hordes of infected and special infected. This benchmark covers the first chapter of the Dead Center campaign, the hotel, on Easy difficulty. The run starts on the hotel rooftop in a fresh campaign. The route leads down through the hotel to an elevator and then through the ground floor to a safe room whose door closes behind the team and loads the next map; the run ends when that happens. A survivor who falls can be revived or healed by teammates.
controls: W, A, S, D move. Left and Right arrow keys turn the view; Up and Down arrow keys look up and down. J fires the equipped weapon (hold for automatic fire). K shoves nearby enemies. E uses or picks up objects, opens doors and presses buttons. R reloads. Space jumps and Left Control crouches. Keys 1 to 5 select the weapon slots (primary, secondary, grenade, health item, pills or adrenaline). Escape opens the pause menu.
